thread:
Oliver Kim: Hi all — I'm Oliver, starting today on Platform eng. Quick blockers: my corporate email hasn't been provisioned in the SSO so I can't access Confluence or the console, and the MDM agent complains about Rosetta on my M1 Mac. Also Slack invite worked but I don't see the #dedicated-capacity channel. Who's best to ping? :wave:
Maya Li: welcome Oliver!! :tada: ping @People Ops for the SSO/email provisioning, and @Dev-Helpdesk for MDM / channel access. For Rosetta error, install Rosetta (`softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license`) and restart the MDM agent.
Oliver Kim: thanks Maya — running the Rosetta install now. People Ops contact? I opened a ticket but haven't heard back.
People Ops: Hi Oliver — we got your ticket (PO-4598). provisioning usually takes ~30-60mins; we'll escalate now. Can you confirm your preferred name and manager?
Oliver Kim: preferred display name is Oliver Kim, manager is Maya Li. Thanks!
ops-bot: New hire checklist assigned to Oliver Kim. Useful links: Confluence onboarding (internal), Slack workspace invite resend, VPN installer. React with :white_check_mark: when you have access.
Oliver Kim: Rosetta install completed, MDM re-run shows one failed policy about "company-cert". Any cert steps?
Dev-Helpdesk: @Oliver Kim the company cert sometimes fails if the system time is off. Can you run `sudo ntpdate -u time.redwood.internal` and then re-run the MDM enrollment? If it still fails, paste the MDM log snippet.
Oliver Kim: ntpdate fixed clock drift, cert installed, MDM succeeded. I can access Confluence but still no access to #dedicated-capacity — says "You don't have permission to view this channel."
Kunal Desai: added you to #dedicated-capacity, try again. Also for console access we'll need to add you to the Platform-Engineers group; pinged the infra-admins.
Oliver Kim: can see the channel now, thanks Kunal. One more: where do I upload my dev laptop spec for inventory and bump my sticker preference? :)
Maya Li: drop the spec in the onboarding Confluence page under Hardware Inventory or DM me. For stickers, we have a sticker request form in the #random channel.
Oliver Kim: sweet. Two fun facts about me: I make a mean boba (brown sugar milk tea) and I once hiked the entire AT (Appalachian Trail) in pieces — ask me for trail recs. :tea:🥾
Maya Li: love both. We'll have a quick intro at 11am PT in #platform — swing by for a 5-min hello if you're free.
Kunal Desai: welcome aboard Oliver! If you want a pairing session this week to get into infra runbooks, ping me.
Oliver Kim: thanks everyone — everything's unblocked now. Marking onboarding checklist items as done. Appreciate the warm welcome :smile:
ops-bot: Onboarding checklist updated: SSO (done), MDM (done), Slack channels (done), Confluence (done).
